summary: Six of six reviewers succeeded (five revise, one block). 39 concerns: 33 fall into 12 agreed groups and 6 are divergent. The structure (pins before moves, variant encoders never merged, shims, source-scan widening) was judged sound. The main gaps are falsifiability: unverified audit counts used as criteria, spec-delegated targets, pins that miss later phases' surfaces, no layer map. The RF0 ledger handoff also collides with public-launch's ledger.

agreed_concerns.title: Audit counts used as pass/fail criteria without RF0 confirmation
agreed_concerns.summary: Numbers the plan admits are unverified (13-module SCC, 11 sites, 47 private imports, 12 patch files) are stated as fact and used as criteria; criteria should be phrased over the RF0-measured inventory.

agreed_concerns.title: Renames and visibility changes contradict RF-R1 without a decision row or shim obligation
agreed_concerns.summary: RF2 renames the model_digest functions, and RF4/RF8 publish or rename names, while RF-R1 preserves API names; old names need listed shims or an explicit ruling.

agreed_concerns.title: RF1 pins do not cover the surfaces RF3, RF4 and RF6 change
agreed_concerns.summary: Pin-before-move is unenforceable for checker verdicts, diff, safefs, assurance, synth oracle and agent_cli behavior, and RF3/RF4/RF6/RF8 do not list 'RF1 pins unchanged'.

agreed_concerns.title: Metric targets are delegated to the spec being gated and can be vacuous
agreed_concerns.summary: RF2-C2, RF3-C2, RF5-C3 and RF6-C1 take thresholds from the spec with no floor; RF5 can split without limit; no stop rule for unreachable targets.

agreed_concerns.title: Completion predicate 4 (thin entry points) has no enforcing criterion
agreed_concerns.summary: No RF5 criterion checks the domain-logic clause and the cli.py ceiling is self-declared.

agreed_concerns.title: No declared layer and lane map, so layering criteria cannot fail
agreed_concerns.summary: Predicate 2's layering test, RF4-C2's 'lane' and the RF1 test scope need a committed module-to-layer assignment.

agreed_concerns.title: RF0 handoff edits public-launch's ledger and test, with a wrong path and a circular gate
agreed_concerns.summary: The ledger is .gnd-planning/milestones/public-launch/migration/units.json, guarded by a public-launch test; RF0 'may run now' yet would edit it mid-sign-off, and the header makes src/gnd edits depend on that same record.

agreed_concerns.title: Ruled decisions are still treated as open, and RF0 criteria miss the handoff
agreed_concerns.summary: Section 10's preamble calls every row a proposal and RF0 is told to settle RF-D2; RF0 criteria do not check the handoff record.

agreed_concerns.title: RF7 deferral not reflected in scope and verification sections
agreed_concerns.summary: Section 1, the Section 3 chain, Section 7 and the Section 9 RF7 row still read as if RF7 runs.

agreed_concerns.title: RF0-C1 accepts any explanation and does not confirm the SCCs later criteria rely on
agreed_concerns.summary: RF4-C1 and RF8-C3 name cycles RF0 never has to confirm; the explanation escape hatch makes RF0-C1 unfailable.

agreed_concerns.title: Monkeypatch and source-scan rules are enforced only in RF5 and conflict with move-only commits
agreed_concerns.summary: RF-R5/RF-R6 need criteria in every moving phase, and a move-only commit must include the test re-point so every commit is green.

agreed_concerns.title: Observable changes hosted inside behavior-preserving phases
agreed_concerns.summary: RF-D6's switch to strict resolver semantics in RF3 and RF-D8's message change in RF8 are observable changes inside phases Section 3 calls behavior-preserving.

prioritized_fixes.title: Audit counts used as pass/fail criteria without RF0 confirmation
prioritized_fixes.action: Mark every audit-derived number at its point of use and restate criteria over the RF0-measured inventory (e.g. every synth.boundary to synth.mutate private import the RF0 tool lists is replaced).

prioritized_fixes.title: RF0 handoff edits public-launch's ledger and test, with a wrong path and a circular gate
prioritized_fixes.action: Name the real ledger path; record the handoff in a code-refactoring record now and change public-launch's ledger and its test only after public-launch Phase 4 sign-off; rewrite the header gate so it is not circular.

prioritized_fixes.title: RF1 pins do not cover the surfaces RF3, RF4 and RF6 change
prioritized_fixes.action: Extend RF1 (or make it a per-spec obligation) with pins over checker verdicts and issue order, diff output, safefs results, assurance and synth-oracle outputs and agent_cli behavior; add 'all RF1 pins unchanged' to RF3, RF4, RF6 and RF8.

prioritized_fixes.title: Metric targets are delegated to the spec being gated and can be vacuous
prioritized_fixes.action: Add an RF-R9 rule: each target derives from the RF0 measurement, is strictly better than baseline, and is owner-approved at the spec gate; give plan-level floors (merged families reach one definition, cli.py ceiling) and a stop rule for unreachable targets and RF5 splits.

prioritized_fixes.title: Completion predicate 4 (thin entry points) has no enforcing criterion
prioritized_fixes.action: Give predicate 4 a check: command modules import domain behavior only from api.py or lane service modules (allow-list), measured by the RF0 tool.

prioritized_fixes.title: No declared layer and lane map, so layering criteria cannot fail
prioritized_fixes.action: Have RF0 commit a module-to-layer and lane map; state the RF1 layering test's scope and widen it as RF4-RF6 add modules; restate RF4-C2 as an edge rule over the map.

prioritized_fixes.title: Renames and visibility changes contradict RF-R1 without a decision row or shim obligation
prioritized_fixes.action: Add a decision row: renames and visibility changes keep the old name importable through a listed shim, and the old name appears in no pinned bytes or digest input; otherwise each rename gets its own ruling.

prioritized_fixes.title: Monkeypatch and source-scan rules are enforced only in RF5 and conflict with move-only commits
prioritized_fixes.action: Add RF-R5/RF-R6 criteria to RF2, RF3, RF4, RF6 and RF8, and define the move-only unit as move plus test re-point with every commit green.

prioritized_fixes.title: Observable changes hosted inside behavior-preserving phases
prioritized_fixes.action: Keep both resolver semantics behind a pinned variant parameter in RF3; move the strict switch and the message change out of preserving phases, or rule them before the spec gate and name them as the phase's only observable change.

prioritized_fixes.title: RF0-C1 accepts any explanation and does not confirm the SCCs later criteria rely on
prioritized_fixes.action: Require RF0 to list every cycle named by a later criterion as confirmed, refuted or new, with differing edges identified; define what RF4-C1 and RF8-C3 mean for an unreproduced cycle.

prioritized_fixes.title: Ruled decisions are still treated as open, and RF0 criteria miss the handoff
prioritized_fixes.action: Split Section 10 into ruled and open rows; RF0 records RF-D1, RF-D2, RF-D7 and settles only RF-D3 to RF-D4; add RF0 criteria for the handoff record and the ownership test.

prioritized_fixes.title: RF7 deferral not reflected in scope and verification sections
prioritized_fixes.action: Annotate Sections 1, 3, 7 and 9 with the RF-D7 deferral.
